entries.title: Security Audit Summary
entries.summary: Reported JWT mismatch, NextAuth issue, missing WS auth, inactive security middleware, weak CSRF, secrets in VCS, CSP/CORS gaps, and more.

entries.title: Repo scan and plan
entries.summary: Identified FastAPI orchestrator, Express server, client, terminal daemon. Planned fixes for JWT, CORS, CSRF, middleware, WS auth, secrets.

entries.title: Security hardening implemented
entries.summary: Added CORS+headers and JWT in orchestrator; Helmet, CORS, rate limit, CSRF in server; client CSRF and secure WS URL; removed committed .env; updated .env.example.

entries.title: Lifecycle logging ensured
entries.summary: Emitted task_started/task_completed and run_started/run_completed; packet events.

entries.title: TUI setup walkthrough provided
entries.summary: Explained daemon WS endpoint, orchestrator, and web TUI dev run commands.

entries.title: Live terminal wired
entries.summary: Terminal page connects to daemon, spawns shell, streams output, handles input and resize; daemon optional HS512 JWT.

entries.title: Secrets bootstrapped and token minted
entries.summary: Generated shared JWT secret, wrote orchestrator and daemon .env files, created dev.jwt for browser.

entries.title: Testing and CI added
entries.summary: Playwright config and basic E2E; CI workflow runs build, Python tests, E2E, API validation, Semgrep and pip-audit.

entries.title: DX improvements
entries.summary: Added bootstrap-env.sh, dev-all.sh, Makefile; README Quickstart and Troubleshooting.

entries.title: Summaries saved
entries.summary: Saved summary-tui.md and chat-log.md with timeline and commands.

entries.title: TUI polish and tooltips
entries.summary: Added keepalive pings, Ctrl+C/D, Clear/Copy/Respawn/Reconnect controls with tooltips; documented Terminal Controls.
